title: ambitious — fellow

sentences.sentence: Alfred was intensely ambitious, obsessed with the idea of becoming rich.
sentences.translation: 艾尔弗雷德雄心勃勃，一心想着发财。

sentences.sentence: There were no secretaries available to take dictation (= write down what someone is saying ) .
sentences.translation: 身边没有秘书记录口授内容。

sentences.sentence: I hate doing French dictations .
sentences.translation: 我讨厌做法语听写。

sentences.sentence: Felicity (to Sally): I guess what I’m saying is this might all be a colossal mistake, as my dad would say, but on the other hand it may…maybe it’ll save my life or something.
sentences.translation: 费利西蒂(对莎莉说): 我猜我想要说的这个可能是个巨大的错误，如同我爸爸说的那样，但是另一方面也许……也许它可拯救我的生命或者别的什么。

sentences.sentence: But watch out for a duck I call Sally.
sentences.translation: 不过请注意一只被我叫做萨莉的鸭子。

sentences.sentence: The kids have been really noisy today.
sentences.translation: 孩子们今天实在是吵。

sentences.sentence: The bar was very noisy.
sentences.translation: 酒吧里非常嘈杂。

sentences.sentence: We are hoping to find a suitable school.
sentences.translation: 我们希望能找到一所合适的学校。

translations.translation: 进入；〔词典等的〕条目；入口

phrases.translation: n. 货物的进口港；人员的入境港；报关港

sentences.sentence: There was no sign of a forced entry.
sentences.translation: 没有强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.sentence: How did the thieves gain entry (= get in )?
sentences.translation: 窃贼是怎样进入的？

sentences.sentence: a dictionary entry
sentences.translation: 词典的条目

sentences.sentence: ...the towering marble archway that marked the entry to the Pelican Point development.
sentences.translation: …标志着鹈鹕顶开发区入口的、高耸的大理石拱门。

sentences.sentence: a drug that has a beneficial effect on the immune system
sentences.translation: 有益于免疫系统的一种药物

sentences.sentence: an arrangement that is mutually beneficial
sentences.translation: 一项互惠互利的协定

sentences.sentence: Competitive intelligence or in other words knowing who your competitors are and what they do and how they do it is essential for any business.
sentences.translation: 竞争智能，或者换句话说，弄清楚谁是你的竞争者，以及他们做什么和怎样在做，是任何商业的要义。

sentences.sentence: A clumsy waiter spilled wine all over her new skirt.
sentences.translation: 一名笨手笨脚的服务员把葡萄酒洒得她新裙子上到处都是。

sentences.sentence: a clumsy attempt to catch the ball
sentences.translation: 笨拙的接球动作

phrases.translation: 凹凸贴图；凸凹处理；凹凸映射

sentences.sentence: The roof was so low he bumped his head (=  his head hit the roof  ) .
sentences.translation: 屋顶很低，他都碰到头了。

translations.translation: 外向的；友好的；外出的；离开的

phrases.translation: 外埠邮件；发文，外发函件

sentences.sentence: We’re looking for someone with an outgoing personality.
sentences.translation: 我们在找一个性格外向的人。

sentences.sentence: the tray for outgoing mail
sentences.translation: 放置外发信件的公文格

sentences.sentence: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
sentences.translation: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

sentences.sentence: Many children buy books after they have been adapted for television.
sentences.translation: 许多小孩子都是在书被改编成电视剧之后才去买的。

sentences.sentence: We should adapt to it.
sentences.translation: 我们必须适应它。

sentences.sentence: How do you adapt to that, especially with the lack of resources there?
sentences.translation: 你如何适应那种情况，特别是在缺乏资源的情况下？

sentences.sentence: But some warn that if they cannot adapt to the changing market they will "die of hunger".
sentences.translation: 但也有一些人警告说，如果他们无法适应不断变化的市场，这些书摊终会“饿死”。

phrases.translation: 台架试验；小型试验（比实验室大，比中型试验小）
净化工作台；无尘无菌操作台
台阶高度；工作台高度；露天矿阶段高度
议会的前座（为反对党领袖保留的座位）

sentences.sentence: We sat on a park bench.
sentences.translation: 我们坐在公园的长椅上。

sentences.sentence: The cancerous cells had to be cut out.
sentences.translation: 癌细胞必须切除。

sentences.sentence: Cut out the bit about racial prejudice.
sentences.translation: 把有关种族歧视的那段删掉。

sentences.sentence: The current advice to pregnant women is to cut out alcohol.
sentences.translation: 给孕妇的当前建议是戒酒。

phrases.translation: 偏光显微镜；偏振显微镜
扫描式隧道显微镜；扫描穿隧显微镜
偏光显微镜，极化显微镜
相差显微镜；相衬显微镜
显微镜载片；显微镜载物片

sentences.sentence: The slightest movement will defocus the microscope.
sentences.translation: 最轻微的运动都会使显微镜散焦。

sentences.sentence: The microscope magnified the object two hundred times.
sentences.translation: 这架显微镜把实物放大了200倍。

sentences.sentence: The microscope capacitates small objects to be observed.
sentences.translation: 显微镜可以观察到微小的物体。

sentences.sentence: Andrew hurried in, slightly out of breath.
sentences.translation: 安德鲁匆匆进来，有点上气不接下气。

phrases.translation: 缺乏，不存在；无…时，缺少…时

sentences.sentence: Ms Leighton will be in charge during my absence (= while I am away ) .
sentences.translation: 我不在时，由莱顿女士负责。

phrases.translation: 同学；（美）领取奖学金的研究生
n. 热诚而令人感到亲切的人

sentences.sentence: She discovered to her pleasure, a talent for making her fellow guests laugh.
sentences.translation: 她高兴地发现一个把她同来的客人逗笑的本事。

sentences.sentence: We all have obligations to our fellow men.
sentences.translation: 我们每个人都对人类负有责任。

sentences.sentence: He stood out in terms of competence from all his fellows.
sentences.translation: 他在能力方面比他所有同事都突出。

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 104 单元

ambitious
音标：英 /æm'bɪʃəs/  美 /æm'bɪʃəs/
adj. 有雄心的；有野心的
例句：Alfred was intensely ambitious, obsessed with the idea of becoming rich.
艾尔弗雷德雄心勃勃，一心想着发财。

dictation
音标：英 /dɪk'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /dɪk'teʃən/
n. 口授；听写（的文字）
例句：There were no secretaries available to take dictation (= write down what someone is saying ) .
身边没有秘书记录口授内容。
例句：I hate doing French dictations .
我讨厌做法语听写。

Sally
音标：英 /'sælɪ/  美 /'sæli/
n. 萨利（女名）
例句：Felicity (to Sally): I guess what I’m saying is this might all be a colossal mistake, as my dad would say, but on the other hand it may…maybe it’ll save my life or something.
费利西蒂(对莎莉说): 我猜我想要说的这个可能是个巨大的错误，如同我爸爸说的那样，但是另一方面也许……也许它可拯救我的生命或者别的什么。
例句：But watch out for a duck I call Sally.
不过请注意一只被我叫做萨莉的鸭子。

noisy
音标：英 /ˈnɔɪzɪ/  美 /ˈnɔɪzɪ/
n. 吵闹的；嘈杂的
短语：noisy channel — 有噪声信道；噪声信道
例句：The kids have been really noisy today.
孩子们今天实在是吵。
例句：The bar was very noisy.
酒吧里非常嘈杂。

suitable
音标：英 /'suːtəb(ə)l/  美 /'sutəbl/
adj. 适合的；适宜的
短语：suitable for — 适合…的，适合于…
短语：suitable temperature — 适用温度；舒适温度
短语：suitable candidate — 合适人选
例句：We are hoping to find a suitable school.
我们希望能找到一所合适的学校。

entry
音标：英 /ˈentrɪ/  美 /'ɛntri/
n. 进入；〔词典等的〕条目；入口
短语：entry into — 进入，加入
短语：data entry — [计]数据输入；资料登录
短语：entry point — [计]入口点；入职薪点；入水点
短语：entry form — 报名表格
短语：no entry — 不准入内；禁止通行
短语：entry into force — 生效
短语：barriers to entry — 进入壁垒；进入障碍
短语：entry fee — 报名费；参赛费；入门费
短语：entry level — 入门级，入学水平
短语：entry permit — 入境许可证
短语：double entry — 复式簿记；复式计帐
短语：port of entry — n. 货物的进口港；人员的入境港；报关港
短语：order entry — 订单输入；买卖盘输入
短语：date of entry — 入境日期；登录日期
短语：entry visa — 入境签证
短语：free entry — 自由加入，自由进入
短语：entry barriers — 进入壁垒；进入障碍
短语：cable entry — 电缆引入线
短语：entry strategies — 进入战略
短语：barrier to entry — 进入市场壁垒
例句：There was no sign of a forced entry.
没有强行闯入的迹象。
例句：How did the thieves gain entry (= get in )?
窃贼是怎样进入的？
例句：a dictionary entry
词典的条目
例句：...the towering marble archway that marked the entry to the Pelican Point development.
…标志着鹈鹕顶开发区入口的、高耸的大理石拱门。

beneficial
音标：英 /benɪ'fɪʃ(ə)l/  美 /,bɛnɪ'fɪʃl/
adj. 有益的；受益的
短语：mutually beneficial — 互利的；双赢的
短语：beneficial owner — 受益所有人
短语：beneficial use — 享用，有权使用
例句：a drug that has a beneficial effect on the immune system
有益于免疫系统的一种药物
例句：an arrangement that is mutually beneficial
一项互惠互利的协定

Marty
马蒂•菲尔丁

in other words
换句话说
例句：Competitive intelligence or in other words knowing who your competitors are and what they do and how they do it is essential for any business.
竞争智能，或者换句话说，弄清楚谁是你的竞争者，以及他们做什么和怎样在做，是任何商业的要义。

clumsy
音标：英 /'klʌmzɪ/  美 /'klʌmzi/
adj. 笨拙的
例句：A clumsy waiter spilled wine all over her new skirt.
一名笨手笨脚的服务员把葡萄酒洒得她新裙子上到处都是。
例句：a clumsy attempt to catch the ball
笨拙的接球动作

bump
音标：英 /bʌmp/  美 /bʌmp/
v. 碰撞；撞击
短语：bump into — 无意中遇到、碰到
短语：with a bump — 意外地，突然
短语：bump against — 撞；碰
短语：bump up — 突然增加；提升
短语：bump off — 干掉]
短语：bump mapping — 凹凸贴图；凸凹处理；凹凸映射
例句：The roof was so low he bumped his head (=  his head hit the roof  ) .
屋顶很低，他都碰到头了。

outgoing
音标：英 /'aʊtgəʊɪŋ/  美 /'aʊt'goɪŋ/
adj. 外向的；友好的；外出的；离开的
短语：outgoing mail — 外埠邮件；发文，外发函件
短语：outgoing message — n. 出局信息
短语：outgoing line — 出线；引出线；出站管线
例句：We’re looking for someone with an outgoing personality.
我们在找一个性格外向的人。
例句：the tray for outgoing mail
放置外发信件的公文格

adapt
音标：英 /ə'dæpt/  美 /ə'dæpt/
v. 使适应；改编
短语：adapt to something — （使）适合；（使）适应
短语：adapt for — 调整，使适合于；为…改编
例句：The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。
例句：Many children buy books after they have been adapted for television.
许多小孩子都是在书被改编成电视剧之后才去买的。

adapt to
使适合
例句：We should adapt to it.
我们必须适应它。
例句：How do you adapt to that, especially with the lack of resources there?
你如何适应那种情况，特别是在缺乏资源的情况下？
例句：But some warn that if they cannot adapt to the changing market they will "die of hunger".
但也有一些人警告说，如果他们无法适应不断变化的市场，这些书摊终会“饿死”。

bench
音标：英 /bentʃ/  美 /bɛntʃ/
n. 长凳
短语：on the bench — 坐板凳；当法官
短语：test bench — 试验台；测试台
短语：bench test — 台架试验；小型试验（比实验室大，比中型试验小）
短语：park bench — 公园长椅
短语：bench blasting — 阶梯式爆破[采矿]
短语：bench scale — n. 实验室规模；台秤
短语：clean bench — 净化工作台；无尘无菌操作台
短语：working bench — 工作台；开采台阶
短语：work bench — 工作台；钳桌
短语：laboratory bench — 试验台，试验工作台
短语：bench mark — n. 准基点（等于benchmark）
短语：collegiate bench — [法]合议庭
短语：bench height — 台阶高度；工作台高度；露天矿阶段高度
短语：bench testing — 台架测试
短语：bench drill — 台钻；台式钻床
短语：bench press — 举重练习凳；台式压床
短语：front bench — 议会的前座（为反对党领袖保留的座位）
例句：We sat on a park bench.
我们坐在公园的长椅上。

cut out
切去；省略；停止（做某事）
例句：The cancerous cells had to be cut out.
癌细胞必须切除。
例句：Cut out the bit about racial prejudice.
把有关种族歧视的那段删掉。
例句：The current advice to pregnant women is to cut out alcohol.
给孕妇的当前建议是戒酒。

microscope
音标：英 /'maɪkrəskəʊp/  美 /'maɪkrəskop/
n. 显微镜
短语：electron microscope — 电子显微镜
短语：scanning electron microscope — 扫描电子显微镜
短语：optical microscope — 光学显微镜
短语：transmission electron microscope — 透射式电子显微镜
短语：light microscope — 光学显微镜；光显微镜
短语：scanning electronic microscope — 扫描电子显微镜
短语：metallographic microscope — [化]金相显微镜
短语：polarizing microscope — 偏光显微镜；偏振显微镜
短语：scanning tunneling microscope — 扫描式隧道显微镜；扫描穿隧显微镜
短语：fluorescence microscope — 荧光显微镜
短语：metallurgical microscope — 金相显微镜
短语：polarized light microscope — 偏光显微镜
短语：interference microscope — 干涉显微镜
短语：polarization microscope — 偏光显微镜，极化显微镜
短语：acoustic microscope — [医]超声显微镜
短语：phase contrast microscope — 相差显微镜；相衬显微镜
短语：inverted microscope — 倒置显微镜
短语：microscope slide — 显微镜载片；显微镜载物片
例句：The slightest movement will defocus the microscope.
最轻微的运动都会使显微镜散焦。
例句：The microscope magnified the object two hundred times.
这架显微镜把实物放大了200倍。
例句：The microscope capacitates small objects to be observed.
显微镜可以观察到微小的物体。

out of breath
上气不接下气
例句：Andrew hurried in, slightly out of breath.
安德鲁匆匆进来，有点上气不接下气。

absence
音标：英 /'æbs(ə)ns/  美 /'æbsns/
n. 缺席；不在某处
短语：absence of — 缺乏
短语：in the absence of — 缺乏，不存在；无…时，缺少…时
短语：absence from — 缺席；不在
短语：in absence — 当…不在的时候；缺席
短语：in absence of — 缺乏…
短语：absence of mind — 心不在焉
例句：Ms Leighton will be in charge during my absence (= while I am away ) .
我不在时，由莱顿女士负责。

fellow
音标：英 /'feləʊ/  美 /'fɛlo/
adj. 同伴的；同类的
n. 同伴；同志；伙伴
短语：research fellow — 研究员，研究人员
短语：young fellow — 小伙子
短语：little fellow — 小家伙，小鬼
短语：fellow countrymen — 同胞
短语：fellow student — 同学；（美）领取奖学金的研究生
短语：poor fellow — 可怜的家伙，可怜的人
短语：old fellow — n. 老兄；老朋友
短语：fellow citizen — 各位公民；同胞
短语：good fellow — n. 热诚而令人感到亲切的人
短语：fellow countryman — 同胞，同乡
短语：fellow servant — n. 同主雇员
例句：She discovered to her pleasure, a talent for making her fellow guests laugh.
她高兴地发现一个把她同来的客人逗笑的本事。
例句：We all have obligations to our fellow men.
我们每个人都对人类负有责任。
例句：He stood out in terms of competence from all his fellows.
他在能力方面比他所有同事都突出。
